notes: UriTemplate::new, set for each variable, then build, on every call. Not passing: a prefix modifier on non-ASCII text is cut by bytes, not characters.
details: The crate keeps the variables inside the template object, so every call copies them in; that is its documented use and is timed. RFC 6570 section 2.4.1 counts a prefix in characters; {title:12} on a title with accented letters is cut after 12 bytes of UTF-8 (fixture 149). There is no option that changes this, so there is no variant.
